description: This Java class 'ProductConfigWorker' provides utility methods for managing product configuration data, including caching, loading, storing, and populating product configuration wrappers within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ProductConfigWorker
classes.description: Utility class for managing product configuration data, including caching, loading, storing, and populating product configuration wrappers within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached ProductConfigWrapper for a given product, currency, and request context.

methods.name: fillProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Populates a ProductConfigWrapper with user-selected options and virtual product variants based on HTTP request parameters.

methods.name: storeProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Stores the current product configuration into the database, updating or creating configuration records.

methods.name: loadProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Creates and loads a ProductConfigWrapper based on a given configuration ID and product details.
